branches.conclusion: Opened official Economics and Management doctoral-school and separate public-management Doctorat en Sciences de Gestion pages. Both show broad management/economics awards without an explicit Operations, Management Science or Industrial Engineering title/specialization. Other host research centers and IAE doctoral routes have not been fully screened.

Opened Faculty of Sciences doctorate school inventory and the full ED 353 Sciences pour l'Ingénieur page. ED 353 explicitly names mechanics, physics, micro/nanoelectronics and eight listed themes, with no Industrial Engineering title. Mathematics/IT and other university doctoral schools are not fully adjudicated, so this is not a university-wide negative.
